text: The Civic Appointments Committee must select candidates to interview for appointment to the Board of Directors of TO Live. Following the interviews, the Civic Appointments Committee will recommend four candidates for appointment to City Council.

The Civic Appointments Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates to interview for appointment to the Board of Directors of TO Live: CTT2-241 CTT2-242 CTT2-283 CTT2-265 CTT2-311 CTT2-317 CTT2-319 CTT2-325 CTT2-336 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (January 3, 2024) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Board of Directors of TO Live.
